description: This file defines the TwoFileRequest class, which encapsulates a pair of strings representing input and output file names, and includes a method to parse such pairs from a request string.

classes.name: TwoFileRequest
classes.description: A class representing a pair of filenames (input and output) and providing a method to parse from a string

methods.name: parseTwoFile
